root_serial_execution.timeout_meaning: Failed/incomplete observation; retain all phase events and stderr, never mark a timeout as pass.

completion_contract: Application-owned queue and ComputeStream; currentWorkCompleted + empty actual-queue command buffer wait before/after throwing ndArray readiness; no sleeps. Empty fence error/status describes itself, not every internal CoreAI command.

auto.snapshot: ready NDArray rawView immediate Data copy

bound.snapshot: actual explicit MTLBuffer contents immediate Data copy

bound-chain.input: original owned shared MTLBuffer -> first explicit buffer -> distinct second explicit buffer
bound-chain.output: explicit shared MTLBuffer on both calls
bound-chain.snapshot: each actual bound buffer, immediately after completion/readiness

memory_limitations: These are accounted logical/application payloads, not peak RSS or GPU allocation guarantees. Runtime specialization, physical padding, residency, automatic output backing/host materialization and allocator overhead are unknown; actual memory can be higher. First snapshot is out of scope before second bound allocation/call.
validation: Exact all-byte finite nonzero pattern v2 and full SHA256; checks ready NDArray shape,dtype,row-major strides. Bound readback tests the actual application buffer, avoiding replacement-allocation ambiguity. First compile failed borrowed capture in metadata condition; split into local getter values, final compile exit0; no execution occurred.
test_scope: x+x mechanical allocation/chaining isolation only. GPU-preferred is not a claim all operations execute exclusively on GPU.
